description: Agent-style tool-call chain: a system prompt with three tools, two user requests, and frozen tool results. The harness feeds each assistant turn back verbatim (content, reasoning and structured tool_calls) and answers every tool call from tool_results, so the transcript depends only on the model's own greedy output. Used by serve_harness --mode chain --tool-chain to exercise session-cache reuse across tool-call turns.
system: You are a careful coding agent working in a Rust repository. Use the tools to inspect files and run tests before you answer. Keep tool arguments exact. When you have enough information, answer concisely with the root cause and a patch.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the repository and return its contents with line numbers.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search the repository for a regular expression and return matching lines as path:line:text.

function.name: run_tests
function.description: Run cargo test with an optional test-name filter and return the test output.
